citation.title: Integrated control of individual plasma scalars with simultaneous neoclassical tearing-mode suppression
citation.authors: Pajares A., Schuster E., Thome K.E., Welander A.S., Barr J.L., Eidietis N.W., Humphreys D.A.

topic: DIII-D integrated feedback control architecture with supervisory/exception handling and optimization-based actuator management. It controls W, volume-average rotation, q0, qe and NTM island width.
own_question: Can individual-scalar controllers and NTM-suppression controllers share NBI, ECH&CD and Ip actuators through real-time optimization? The tests use COTSIM simulations and one FF-only/FF+FB DIII-D shot pair (185362, 185374).
actual_method_and_evidence: The controllers are Lyapunov-based robust controllers built on 0D models. Arbitration uses a slack-variable optimization weighted by priorities. The paper assumes real-time estimates of W, Ωφ, q and w exist from reconstruction. It does not address nowcasting of CES ion temperature or diagnostic latency. The experimental evidence is one FF-only and one FF+FB shot in a high-qmin scenario. In those shots, q0 controllability was low and the ECCD was mis-steered because of a PCS setup issue. The authors judged the observed modes to be likely TMs rather than NTMs.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Integrated tokamak control architectures assume that real-time estimates of plasma state quantities are available to feedback controllers.
claim_checks.qualification: The estimated quantities here are W, rotation, q and island width. The paper says nothing about CES Ti or impurity temperature. Treat it as motivation only. It does not show that a nowcast would improve control.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: No CES, BES or ECEI inputs. The only timing information given is the feedback filter cutoff and that rotation measurements require NBI modulation. Report latency is unknown.
validation_if_relevant: Validation is a single shot comparison plus simulation. It does not use held-out data splits.
forbidden_inferences: Do not imply that this paper used CES nowcasts or needs them.
Do not cite it as evidence that a temperature nowcast improves control performance.
Do not generalize this paper's measurement assumptions to all integrated control work.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, cite it once as an optional application context: control systems consume real-time state estimates. It has no bearing on our estimator, inputs, targets or validation.
